name: Camp Blackwater
tagline: A Halloween campfire tale: the last night of summer, a storm on the lake, and a legend in a burlap mask.
description: A Halloween slasher-movie night, without the gore. The campers have gone home, the counselors are having one last bonfire, and the phone line is down. Everyone knows the story of the Lakeside Man. Tonight, somebody used it.
artStyle: 1980s horror VHS cover art, pine forest at night, lake mist, a campfire's orange glow, grainy film

cocktails.name: The Lakeside Man
cocktails.recipe: Dark rum, ginger beer and lime over ice, with a blackberry sunk to the bottom.
cocktails.mocktail: Ginger beer, lime and blackberries over ice.

cocktails.name: Campfire S'mores Shake
cocktails.recipe: Vanilla ice cream, chocolate liqueur and toasted marshmallow, blended.
cocktails.mocktail: Vanilla ice cream, chocolate syrup and a toasted marshmallow on top.
